question.text: Per SEBI PM Regulations, portfolio managers MUST report performance:

answer.text: Net of all fees, expenses, and taxes

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI mandates NET-of-fees reporting — what the investor actually realises. Gross figures can be misleading. The Trap: Some PMs historically reported gross; SEBI tightened this in PM Regs 2020. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A covers from Distributor side; XXI-B from PM compliance. Manager's Pro-Tip: Maintain both gross and net books — SEBI inspections check tie-outs. Also disclose cash-drag adjustments.
